prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury attorney for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, the facts of the crash, insurance limits, whether the case will require litigation, and your preferences. That said, Chicago has many very experienced plaintiff personal-injury firms and trial lawyers who handle serious car-accident claims.

Names and places to consider (well-known Chicago personal-injury firms/teams that frequently handle car-accident and wrongful-death claims)
- Clifford Law Offices
- Corboy & Demetrio
- Levin & Perconti
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard
- Romanucci & Blandin

How to choose the right attorney
- Experience with similar car-accident claims (severity of injury, fatality, multi-vehicle, uninsured/underinsured motorist).
- Trial experience and a record of taking cases to verdict (not all cases settle; you want someone who can litigate).
- Resources: ability to hire accident reconstructionists, medical experts, vocational experts, etc.
- Communication style and responsiveness.
- Fee structure (most PI lawyers work on contingency — typically a percentage of the recovery — and advance costs).
- Client reviews and peer-recognition (AV ratings, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Illinois Trial Lawyers Association).
- Clean disciplinary record (check Illinois ARDC).

Questions to ask at a free consult
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the outcomes?
- Will you or another attorney handle my case day-to-day?
- Do you try cases? How many jury trials in the last 5 years?
- What is your fee and how are costs handled?
- Who pays for medical liens and expert witnesses until resolution?
- How long do you expect my case to take?

Next step I can take for you
- If you tell me a few case details (date, injuries, who was at fault, insurance situation, location/zip code), I can suggest 2–4 attorneys or firms in Chicago that would be a good fit and include tips on contacting them.

Would you like me to recommend specific attorneys based on your case details?
